title: Wi-Fi
intro: How busy each access point is, how many clients it has and which channel it is on, drawn on the floor plan. From the Wi-Fi plugins; refreshed every 30 seconds.
busyNone: None at {{pct}}% channel use or more
planLabel: Access points on the floor plan, {{band}} GHz
keyLoad: Colour: channel use. Green below 50%, amber to {{pct}}%, red above. A dashed red ring: another AP nearby is on the same channel.
keyClients: Colour: clients on this band. Red at {{count}} or more.
keyChannels: Colour and number: the channel. A dashed red ring: another AP nearby is on the same channel.
notPlaced: No access point is on the floor plan yet. Place them in the editor like switches (they come from the inventory), and they show here with their load.
overlapTitle: Access points on the same channel near each other
unplacedHint_one: {{count}} access point isn't on the floor plan, or its name doesn't match one in the inventory.
unplacedHint_other: {{count}} access points aren't on the floor plan, or their names don't match the inventory.
privacy: From {{sources}}. Client counts only: Floorbit never asks for or keeps who is connected.
noPlugin: No Wi-Fi plugin is on. Turn on UniFi under Settings > Plugins, or add a plugin with uses: [wifi].
